rules: Official organizer sources preferred; secondary calendar records clearly marked provisional.
Do not reuse historical routes/GPX as 2027 tracks.
A Google Earth route, street list or course description is not a validated GPX file.
Do not delete or overwrite old GPX files until a new official binary is downloaded and parsed.
Audit-only; no live event records or runtime files changed.
